sql: SELECT m.organization_id, m.notice_id, m.section_id, m.name, m.raw_identifier, m.scheme, m.country, n.published_at FROM organization_mentions m JOIN notices n ON n.id = m.notice_id WHERE m.organization_id IN (31562628,31607602,31562686,31645298,31611304,31622550,31591848,31612560,31618870,31562625,31594838,31600628) LIMIT 100
note: per-mention rows with notice dates for the 12 smaller members/movers (UoM and Riverside twins excluded, read grouped in c1-04)

sql: SELECT notice_id, section_id, field_id, ordinal, substr(value, 1, 260) AS value FROM notice_texts WHERE notice_id IN (46788314, 46788461, 46861912, 46869222, 46888176, 46905428, 46915660, 46946991, 46936102, 47148719, 47163373) AND section_id IN ('PROCEDURE', 'ORG-GB-CHC-Registered Charity No. 1104951', 'ORG-GB-CHC-1104951', 'ORG-GB-CHC-Charity Registration No. 221124', 'ORG-GB-CHC-221124', 'ORG-GB-MPR-21256R', 'ORG-GB-MPR-IP21256R', 'ORG-GB-MPR-Reg No 30938R', 'ORG-GB-CHC-Registered Charity No 1077607', 'ORG-GB-CHC-Charity number: 1179683', 'ORG-GB-CHC-Registered Charity No. 518753', 'ORG-GB-MPR-IP27566R') LIMIT 300
note: BT-500 org name and BT-21/24 procedure text for the 11 notices; context: buyer/supplier role, dates

sql: SELECT id, identifier, name, provisional FROM organizations WHERE country = 'GB' AND identifier_kind = 'national' AND identifier IN ('GBCHC1104951','GBCHCREGISTEREDCHARITYNO1104951','GBCHC221124','GBCHCCHARITYREGISTRATIONNO221124','GBMPR21256R','GBMPRIP21256R','GBMPR30938R','GBMPRREGNO30938R','GBUKPRN10007798','GBUKPRNUKPRN10007798','GBCHC1077607','GBCHCREGISTEREDCHARITYNO1077607','GBCHC1179683','GBCHCCHARITYNUMBER1179683','GBCHC518753','GBCHCREGISTEREDCHARITYNO518753','GBMPR27566R','GBMPRIP27566R','GBMPR30011R','GBMPR20453R','GBMPR20453','GBMPR30011','GBCHC11049511','GBMPRIP30938R') LIMIT 100
note: organizations_identity holders of the 9 canonical + 9 stored values, plus predecessor numbers GBMPR30011R/20453R(R), none held

sql: SELECT organization_id, name, raw_identifier, scheme, country, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(notice_id) AS first_notice, MAX(notice_id) AS last_notice FROM organization_mentions WHERE organization_id IN (30914487, 31600847) GROUP BY organization_id, name, raw_identifier, scheme, country LIMIT 100
note: grouped mention names for twins 30914487 (Riverside) and 31600847 (UoM)
